## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 459 captures during March 2026. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and indicates the volume submitted for image assessment. Capture activity should continue to be monitored through routine operational review, with any emerging issues recorded and followed up through the appropriate service arrangements.

## Image quality

There were 27 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 5.9. This result should be reviewed alongside local capture procedures and any recurring equipment or image-acquisition issues. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be investigated and managed through the established support process.

## Grading

Grading identified 137 referable captures. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This provides an overview of grading timeliness for March 2026 and should be considered with the referable outcome and image-quality findings. Continued review of turnaround and grading outcomes will support routine monitoring of service performance at West Gate Eye Clinic.
